Definition: from G770; a scruple of conscience:--infirmity.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says the strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and the word means the scruples and tender consciences that make a brother hesitate. It is the only place it appears.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that bearing with a weaker brother is not a burden to resent, it is the way Christ bore with us.
